scope: Same-index fixed-degree polynomial-in-m Bezout combinations of the fully Cartier-normalized mixed-cubic residue pair.

theorem.raw: limsup |A(m)lambda_0,m+B(m)lambda_1,m|^(1/m)=rho_star for every nonzero A,B in Q[m]
theorem.normalized: limsup root equals rho_star*exp(-C_F) after fixed-denominator clearing
theorem.exact_obstruction: the only degree tie would require the nonreal critical ratio q(alpha)/f0(alpha); its minimal cubic is 320t^3-400t^2+220t-11 with negative discriminant

strict_scope_boundary: no claim about the gcd itself
no claim for growing polynomial degree or adaptive coefficients
no claim for a joint resultant or subresultant of two combinations
